Prisons Act
(Chapter 247, Section 20(1))
Appointment of Superintendents of Prisons
N 4
G.N. No. S 395/1999
REVISED EDITION 2001
(31st January 2001)
The Minister for Home Affairs has appointed the officers of the institutions specified in the Schedule to be Superintendents of Prisons with effect from the dates indicated therein.

THE SCHEDULE
With effect from
1.[Cancelled by G.N. No. 647/2005, wef 01/04/2005].
2.Superintendent, Kaki Bukit Centre.
4th January 1994
3.Superintendent, Lloyd Leas Community Supervision Centre.
12th February 2000
